title: Patents (Priority Protection) Order, S.I. 2005, No. 158
text:
Statutory Instruments Supplement No. 70
Supplement to Official Gazette No.1 06 dated 19th December, 2005
S.1. 2005 No. 158
Patents Act
Cap. 314
PATENTS (PRIORITY PROTECTION) ORDER, 2005
The Minister in exercise of the powers conferred on him by
Section 21 (4) of the Patents Act, makes the following Order:
1. This Order may be cited as the Patents (Priority Protection)
Order. 2005.
2. The countries referred to in the Schedule are those which are S,hed"le.
convention countries for the purposes of Section 21 (4) of the Patents Act.

2 STATUTORY INSTRUMENT
SCHEDULE
(Paragraph 2)
CONVENTION COUNTRIES
1. All members of the World Trade Organization, established In
Marrakesh, Morocco on April 15, 1994,
2. All parties to the Paris Convention.
Made byt he Minister this 12th dayof December, 2005.
DALE D, MARSHALL
